2317-4826-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-3899.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-3899.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

147-313-728.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-2738-4871-4976.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Open the Graves, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-4013-7894.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{C}.
654-4013-7894.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability triggers, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.

4377-4477-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from exile to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1594-4399-4770-5870.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-5870.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

489-1090-1594-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-4720-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {U}{R}, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste that enters prepared.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Lizard or Wizard creature you control.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U/R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 an additional time.
Repeat.
2440-4720-7546.notes:
Mana needed drops significantly for each additional creature you control that is a Lizard or Wizard.

Note that Stonework Packbeast is a Wizard.

240-1322-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4559-5272-6757-6797.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5272-6757-6797.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

955-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
955-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

1061-2079-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-2079-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-2079-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

321-399-1796-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2692-2893-3875-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

252-4871-6965.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-6965.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

413-3817-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

997-2232-3542-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
997-2232-3542-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

972-1018-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-1018-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Skullwinder and the Great Whale token.
When the Skullwinder and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-1018-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Skullwinder instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

3174-5571-6798--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-1810-2743.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Cackling Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterpart spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2014-3055-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

803-5296-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}
Repeat.
803-5296-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Workhorse for additional mana.

222-527-2034-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
222-527-2034-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1594-1690-2538-2585.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Stone Calendar.
1594-1690-2538-2585.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1594-1690-2538-2585.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

280-643-1399-1606.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1477-1737-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1912-4499-5420.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Pirate.
When Plundering Pirate enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-3908-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1636-1660-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1660-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures and/or lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-1660-5996.description:
Activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1857-2178-4102.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1857-2178-4102.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1957-4067-5308.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in hand.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
1957-4067-5308.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a creature card.
Confessor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

662-4694-4853.notablePrerequisites: Liquimetal Coating does not have summoning sickness.
662-4694-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, turning an opponent's land into an artifact.
The land becomes a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Liquimetal Coating.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1738-3779.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-1738-3779.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Serra Avatar and gaining life equal to its power.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Serra Avatar's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

938-1283-1582-3771-5231.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-1283-1582-3771-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {R}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard for {1}.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

466-2034-2835.notablePrerequisites: You have one or more cards in hand.
466-2034-2835.description:
Activate Saproling Cluster by discarding a card and paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sparoling token, adding {C}{C}.
Fecundity triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat.
